title: Specificity Conflict

bugs.fix:
p.highlight { color: red; }
p { color: blue; }
bugs.explanation: Using `!important` breaks the natural cascade and makes CSS harder to maintain. Instead of adding `!important`, increase specificity or restructure the rules so they apply in the correct order without forced overrides.

title: Margin Collapsing
box-sizing border-box

bugs.explanation: By default `box-sizing: content-box` adds padding and border to the element's declared width, causing overflow. Set `box-sizing: border-box` globally so padding and border are included within the specified width.

`z-index` only works on positioned elements (`position: relative`, `absolute`, `fixed`, or `sticky`). On a statically positioned element it has no effect. Add `position: relative` (or another positioning) to enable `z-index`.

title: Stacking Context
min-width 0 for Flex Overflow

bugs.explanation: Flex items have `min-width: auto` by default, which prevents them from shrinking below their content size. Adding `min-width: 0` allows the item to shrink and makes `overflow: hidden` / `text-overflow: ellipsis` work correctly.

title: Grid Template Areas

bugs.explanation: CSS custom property references use `var()`, not `va()`. The typo `va(--brand)` is invalid and the property will be ignored (background will be transparent or default). Correct to `var(--brand)`.

The `content` property is required for `::before` and `::after` pseudo-elements. Missing the value (and the semicolon) makes the whole rule invalid. Use `content: ''` for visual pseudo-elements that have no text content.
